speaker: john_heminges
text: The reckoning stands thus. Your share, Will, six-and-thirty shillings.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six-and-thirty. Last Saturday was forty. I have both.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Six-and-thirty is a week. Forty was a better week. I will take today's, and I will not average them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The share is the pay. Six-and-thirty. Last Saturday forty, the spring's best, and this is not that Saturday. The chest is not on this sheet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The chest is not counted. The share is the share.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Six-and-thirty, and I am not asking it to be forty. The doors opened. That is as much cause as I need.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Four shillings under the best week of the spring, and my throat is no better for it. I will take the silver, and the ale after.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the sheet is the share. No lease. No timber. Six-and-thirty shillings, and the book shuts on that.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Shut it. A giant can wait until someone else is paying for the ale.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut. Six-and-thirty. Nothing of the lease on this sheet.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nothing of the lease. I am not carrying it into an alehouse.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Rose had a second Hercules new yesterday. I am gloomy about giants. I have not got their sum, and I am not naming one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then be gloomy at the Jackdaw, John. The settle will go if we stand here loving a sheet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six-and-thirty. Forty last Saturday. The chest stays shut. I am for the settle when this is shut.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I am for home. I have the sum, and I have a door.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And I. Six-and-thirty spends as well in a kitchen.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Say it back, Will, and then we are done with the sheet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six-and-thirty shillings. Forty last Saturday. The chest stays shut.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Said, and heard. The lane is cooler than this yard. Come.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I have heard it twice. That is enough for a man who is going home.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Twice is a fair hearing. Good night. I am not your giant.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book is shut. Six-and-thirty. Dick, I will walk as far as the lane with you and Will, and spend the gloom where the ale is.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Out, then. Mistress Tipping keeps a settle, and I am thirsty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My pouch is tied. Six-and-thirty, and not a penny of it counted into the chest.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good night, Tom. Good night, Austin. The book is shut on six-and-thirty.
